Hi Elena — appreciate the clear ask and the questionnaire. We've reviewed internally and can propose two practical paths that preserve the evaluation cadence without a full contract negotiation:

Option A (short stretch + retainer):
- Add 14 days to the existing pilot (same model/throughput limits).
- Redwood provides an SLA commitment of 99.9% for the 14-day window (operational credit if missed).
- Add a one-time engineering retainer of 40 hours (on-call debug + tuning) billed as a fixed line item at a discounted rate; unused hours backstop into a post-pilot health review.
- Price impact: one-time retainer fee of $18,000 and 15% off our standard pilot hourly surge rate for the extension period.

Option B (temp dedicated uplift):
- Move the pilot to a temporary Dedicated pool for the remainder of the evaluation (higher concurrency).
- SLA 99.9% guaranteed for the dedicated window; includes 60 eng hours and priority routing.
- Price impact: committed short-term capacity at a 10% uplift on the monthly dedicated reservation prorated to the pilot days; ops credit of $6,000 applied toward professional services.

Both options include completion of your security questionnaire (thanks for sending). If you prefer, we can draft a short pilot addendum (one-page) that captures whichever option you pick and a DocuSign link for signature.

I've looped David and Irene to confirm finance/ops feasibility; David — can we create a one-page addendum and an invoice path for Option A quickly if MedStage confirms?
